doc.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995

title: Size and members of the band
summary: Tate counts five saxes and trombones and names players such as Prez, Sweets, Buck and Vic Dickenson.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What size was the band at that time? Who was —

Well, we got about one, two, three, got five saxes. One, two three. Let’s see Prez, Jack, yeah, there’s five saxes. One, two, three, four, five. Five saxophones. And maybe four or five trombones. There’s Sweets and Buck. Vic Dickenson, Dan Minor.
